claims.text: FAIR (15 outlets, 10–11 Aug 2025 on al-Sharif): all 15 reported Israel's Hamas allegation; NYT, NBC, Fox and WSJ put it in headline or subhead; six omitted his final statement; only WSJ and Washington Post noted the other journalists were not accused; 13 cited the number of journalists killed, only 4 named Israel as primary perpetrator; Reuters changed headline from 'Israel Kills Al Jazeera Journalist It Says Was Hamas Leader'; NYT, Reuters and BBC used 'Hamas-run' for Gaza figures.

Henry Jackson Society (Dec 2024): of 1,378 articles Feb–May 2024, 98% cited ministry figures, 84% did not distinguish combatants from civilians, 19% used ministry figures without attribution; alleges errors in ministry lists (ages, sexes), inclusion of natural deaths; argues the ministry is a party-controlled source and figures likely overstated; urges equal scrutiny of IDF combatant claims.
